text_en: You then, my child, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus;
text_cn: 所以，我儿！你应因那在基督耶稣内的恩宠坚强起来，

text_en: and what you have heard from me through many witnesses entrust to faithful people who will be able to teach others as well.
text_cn: 应把你在许多证人前由我所听的，传授给忠信可靠的人，使他们也能够教导别人。

text_en: Share in suffering like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
text_cn: 应如同基督耶稣的精兵，与我共受劳苦。

text_en: No one serving in the army gets entangled in everyday affairs; the soldier’s aim is to please the enlisting officer.
text_cn: 没有一个当兵的为叫他的元帅喜欢，而让日常的俗务缠身的。

text_en: And in the case of an athlete, no one is crowned without competing according to the rules.
text_cn: 若有人竞赛，除非按规矩竞赛，是得不到花冠的。

text_en: It is the farmer who does the work who ought to have the first share of the crops.
text_cn: 劳苦的农夫，理当先享受产物。

text_en: Think over what I say, for the Lord will give you understanding in all things.
text_cn: 你要了解我所说的话；其实主必要赐你了解一切。

text_en: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, a descendant of David—that is my gospel,
text_cn: 你务要记住：根据我所传的福音，达味的后裔耶稣基督从死者中复活了。

text_en: for which I suffer hardship, even to the point of being chained like a criminal. But the word of God is not chained.
text_cn: 为了这福音，我受苦以至带锁链，如同凶犯一样；但是天主的道，决束缚不住。

text_en: Therefore I endure everything for the sake of the elect, so that they may also obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
text_cn: 为此，我为蒙选的人忍受一切，为使他们也获得那在基督耶稣内的救恩和永远的光荣。

text_en: The saying is sure: If we have died with him, we will also live with him;
text_cn: 这话是确实的：如果我们与他同死，也必与他同生；

text_en: if we endure, we will also reign with him; if we deny him, he will also deny us;
text_cn: 如果我们坚忍到底，也必与他一同为王； 如果我们否认他，他也必要否认我们；

text_en: if we are faithless, he remains faithful— for he cannot deny himself.
text_cn: 如果我们不忠信，他仍然是忠信的，因为他不能否认自己。

text_en: Remind them of this, and warn them before God that they are to avoid wrangling over words, which does no good but only ruins those who are listening.
text_cn: 你要提醒人这些事：在天主前恳切劝戒他们，不要在言词上争辩，因为争辩除能颠覆听众外，丝毫没有益处。

text_en: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved by him, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly explaining the word of truth.
text_cn: 你要努力在天主前，显示自己是经得起考验的，是无愧的工人，正确地讲授真理之言。

text_en: Avoid profane chatter, for it will lead people into more and more impiety,
text_cn: 至于那凡俗的空谈，务要躲避，因为这些空谈，多使人趋于不敬。

text_en: and their talk will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
text_cn: 这些人的言论如同毒癌，愈烂愈大；其中就有依默纳约和非肋托，

text_en: who have swerved from the truth by claiming that the resurrection has already taken place. They are upsetting the faith of some.
text_cn: 他们离开了真理，说复活已是过去的事，颠覆了一些人的信仰。

text_en: But God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this inscription: “The Lord knows those who are his, ” and, “Let everyone who calls on the name of the Lord turn away from wickedness. ”
text_cn: 但是天主坚固的基础，屹立不动，且有这样的刻文说：“主认识那些属于他的人。”又说：“凡呼号主名的人，应远离邪恶。”

text_en: In a large house there are utensils not only of gold and silver but also of wood and clay, some for special use, some for ordinary.
text_cn: 在大户家庭中，不但有金器和银器，而且也有木器和瓦器；有作贵重之用的，也有作卑贱之用的；

text_en: All who cleanse themselves of the things I have mentioned will become special utensils, dedicated and useful to the owner of the house, ready for every good work.
text_cn: 所以人若自洁，离开卑贱的，必然成为贵重的，圣洁的，有益于主人，便利行各种善工的器皿。

text_en: Shun youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, along with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.
text_cn: 你要躲避青年的贪欲，但要同那些以纯洁之心呼号主的人们，追求正义、信德、爱德与平安。

text_en: Have nothing to do with stupid and senseless controversies; you know that they breed quarrels.
text_cn: 至于那些愚昧和粗野的辩论，务要躲避，因为你知道辩论只会产生争吵。

text_en: And the Lord’s servant must not be quarrelsome but kindly to everyone, an apt teacher, patient,
text_cn: 主的仆人不应当争吵，但要和气对待众人，善于教导；凡事忍耐，

text_en: correcting opponents with gentleness. God may perhaps grant that they will repent and come to know the truth,
text_cn: 以温和开导反抗的人，或许天主会赐他们悔改而认识真理，

text_en: and that they may escape from the snare of the devil, having been held captive by him to do his will.
text_cn: 使这些被魔鬼活捉去顺从他心意的人，能觉悟过来，摆脱魔鬼的罗网。
